title: Legion baseball: Fort uses late push to edge East Troy, 9-8 - NewsBreak
text: Fort Atkinson’s American Legion Post 166 19U baseball team scored the go-ahead run in the sixth inning, fending off East Troy 9-8 at Jones Park on Tuesday. The Hawks trailed 7-1 through three innings but clawed back with a three-run fourth and four-run sixth. The first two hitters of the Fort sixth reached on East Troy infield errors (two of seven committed by the visitors). Alexis Martinez then singled to center to load the bases. Gavin Kanters dug in next, singling to right. His hit plated three runs, two of which came around on first baseman Brayden Phillips’ error. Kanters then scored on a passed ball to make it 9-7 Hawks. Martinez came on to pitch the ninth, but got himself in a bases-loaded one-out jam after a hit batter and consecutive walks. After Seth Lingford scored on a wild pitch, Martinez punched out Nolan Apriesnig and Phillips to end it. East Troy scored seven earned runs on nine hits off Fort starter Jordan Zahn in the first three innings. The Hawks pulled within 7-5 in the fourth, which saw Braiden Wainwright single to lead off the inning, steal second and score from there on Isaiah Maier’s line drive single to center. With one away, Martinez delivered an RBI triple on a fly ball to right field. Kanters followed with a run-scoring sacrifice fly. Benett Thompson, Brady Byrnes and Martinez tallied two hits apiece. Martinez scored three runs and Kanters drove in three runs. Fort’s Colin Schrader pitched 2 2/3 innings of scoreless relief to earn the decision. He struck out three, walked none and gave up two hits. Fort hosts Racine on Wednesday, July 9 at 6:30 p.m. FORT ATKINSON 9, EAST TROY 8 East Troy 331 000 1 — 8 11 7 Fort 200 304 x — 9 9 1 Leading hitters — ET: Moat 2x4, Apriesnig 2x4; FA: Martinez 2x4 (3B), Thompson 2x3, Byrnes 2x4 Pitching (ip-h-r-er-bb-so) — ET: Bayley 3.2-5-5-3-2-2, Apriesnig L; 2.1-4-4-0-0-3; FA: Zahn 3-9-7-7-2-2, Schrader W; 2.2-2-0-0-0-3, Martinez 1-0-1-1-2-2 Subscribe to Daily Jefferson County Union
